answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because mesa only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, comet is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any island approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
